slot-66f9526c-a502-4b9d-b34d-5005fa8a551.quote_span: Haiti's Provisional Electoral Council has postponed indefinitely the initial stages of the electoral process, putting the country on track to mark 10 years without holding national elections.
slot-66f9526c-a502-4b9d-b34d-5005fa8a551.speaker: Haiti's Provisional Electoral Council
slot-66f9526c-a502-4b9d-b34d-5005fa8a551.checkable_against: Provisional Electoral Council announcement and Haiti election records

slot-855857e3-bc61-4619-bf1e-b683c9fd5ab.quote_span: The delay, announced Tuesday after a Council of Ministers meeting, suspends the first round of presidential and legislative elections scheduled for Dec. 13, 2026.
slot-855857e3-bc61-4619-bf1e-b683c9fd5ab.speaker: outlet's own
slot-855857e3-bc61-4619-bf1e-b683c9fd5ab.checkable_against: Provisional Electoral Council election calendar and Council of Ministers records

slot-113271ce-b886-433d-9b67-4923f6c0f1a.quote_span: The original schedule called for a runoff on Feb. 21, 2027.
slot-113271ce-b886-433d-9b67-4923f6c0f1a.speaker: outlet's own

slot-fc8a995a-51de-4a55-a9b9-e7a7b86c180.quote_span: The council also extended the deadline for candidates to register and submit required documents until Oct. 31.
slot-fc8a995a-51de-4a55-a9b9-e7a7b86c180.speaker: Provisional Electoral Council
